description: Full details of one villa: description, highlights, facilities, bedrooms, bathrooms, who it sleeps, minimum stay, location, photos, each bedroom option with its lowest rate, and the published seasonal nightly rates still to come. Give the villa's slug (from search_villas), its name, or its id. Rates are per night in the chosen currency before 13% local taxes.

villa.description: The villa's slug (for example alila), name (for example Alila) or numeric id.
